module.name: app:views/features/application/enterprise-app-auth-application/ui/app-auth-review
module.jsdoc:
@module app:views/features/application/enterprise-app-auth-application/ui/app-auth-review
职责：承接单次 C06D 审核工具的原记录选择、按键读回、审核决定和撤销未提交意见。
边界：列表只提供展示和原行读取证明，查询审核详情、编辑和提交全部沿独立审核 DataView。
AI用途：接入审核规则回调时复用这一能力，保持原记录、会话与操作结果的归属。

ReviewOptions.name: ReviewOptions
ReviewOptions.jsdoc: Single-call bindings supplied by the native review entry after it resolves both formal views.

attributes.name: list
attributes.jsdoc: Original list view for finding the selected request and retaining its read proof.

attributes.name: audit
attributes.jsdoc: Record-scoped view for reading the formal request and saving authorized decision fields.

methods.name: isCurrent
methods.jsdoc: Confirm that this review tool still belongs to the authorized page invocation.

methods.name: showSuccess
methods.jsdoc: Present the business message after the original save receipt confirms the decision.
